notes: «و أما الأخبار ... في حياة الصادق» is the chapter preamble, not a link; «ما حدثنا به أبي» gives a bare father, a relation (rule 7)
«وَ» joins فضالة and الحسن as co-transmitters in one level (rule 2)
«قال قال أبو عبد الله ع» : the Imam named in the words after the chain is the last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the blessing is left out
